days.summary: Explore iconic South Mumbai landmarks and enjoy the coastal charm.

items.activity: Visit the majestic Gateway of India, a historic monument.
Explore the vibrant Colaba Market for souvenirs and local handicrafts.
Lunch at a mid-budget restaurant in Colaba like Leopold Cafe or Cafe Mondegar.
Visit the Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Vastu Sangrahalaya (museum).
Stroll along Marine Drive (Queen's Necklace) and enjoy the sunset.
Dinner at a restaurant with views of Marine Drive or in Fort area.

days.summary: Discover Mumbai's cultural diversity and local life.

items.activity: Visit Haji Ali Dargah, a beautiful mosque situated on an islet.
Experience the unique Dhobi Ghat, the world's largest outdoor laundry.
Lunch at a local eatery near Mahalaxmi or Lower Parel.
Explore the vibrant Bandra neighborhood, walk along Bandstand, and browse Linking Road.
Relax at a cafe in Bandra and enjoy the lively atmosphere.
Farewell dinner at a popular restaurant in Bandra.
